gaps.detail: Defaults/includes, modes and modification application are not fully resolved.
Generic module lists are not active crew/equipment. Positions, sizes, transforms and armor layer ordering require an authored geometry map.
No complete penetration curve, equivalent armor or preset definitions; existing engine lacks these modern effects. Never use hitPower as penetration.
Shot reload time, pitch limits, stabilizer and sight FOV/offset/rangefinder behavior are missing; rack replenishment is not reload.
IR versus thermal, installed upgrades and autoloader presence require explicit resolution; dummy_weapon cannot fire.
All source data remains warthunder_reference; game release date is not historical variant year.
